metadata.description: Image/video-generation tooling: the nano-banana CLI and the image skill

plugins.name: image
plugins.description: Generates and edits images and videos via Google Nano Banana (Gemini Image API), Gemini Omni (Gemini video): text-to-image, image-to-image and text/image-to-video, model-aware ratios/resolutions, driven by the bundled nano-banana CLI
